Salary is one part of Autodesk’s competitive compensation package. Offers are based on the candidate’s experience, educational level, and geographic location.

jobs.location: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
jobs.description:
What Makes Us, Us  

Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!  

WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

Our Accounting team is growing and we are looking for more team members to join. If you are curious, collaborative and enjoy taking initiative this could be a great place to work. You do not need to have all answers from day one. What matters to us is that you are open to learning, willing to try and comfortable to step into new challenges.

At SimCorp, we support some of the largest financial institutions in the world to be successful by simplifying their investments, accounting and operations.

Accounting is a unit within SimCorp’s Product Division which delivers all rules and calculation methods in order to provide our clients with a legally binding subledger for all supported asset classes.

What You Will Be Responsible For

Develop and maintain features in the Accounting product areas.
Contribute across the entire development lifecycle - from requirements analysis and design to implementation, test automation, documentation, and ongoing support.
Collaborate closely with teammates, Product Managers, and Architects to deliver high-quality and secure solutions.
Create, document and maintain test cases and automated tests to cover the features’ acceptance criteria (system, integration, unit etc.)
Uphold engineering best practices and contribute to continuous improvement.
Learn deeply about our Accounting domain and understand how our products support customer outcomes.
Be open to feedback, mentorship, and knowledge sharing in your team.

Your Skills

Most importantly, you can see yourself contributing and thriving in the position described above. How you gained the skills needed for doing that is less important. We expect you to be good at several of the following and be able to - and interested in - learn the rest.

Confident in software engineering fundamentals, including algorithms and data structures.
Willingness to learn and work with in-house tools and frameworks, especially the APL programming language.
Proficiency in at least one object-oriented or functional programming language (C# is a benefit).
Familiarity with modern engineering tools and practices, including CI/CD and trunk-based development.
Experience working with relational databases and SQL.
Readiness to work in a complex accounting domain, dealing with financial and investment-related instruments.
Good English skills (upper-intermediate or higher), both written and spoken.
Experience with cloud technologies and fintech domain is a plus.

What Is It Like To Work Here

SimCorp plans work in an agile manner, using 4 planning intervals (PI’s) per year, each consisting of 5 sprints of 2 weeks each, followed by a 3-week Innovation and Planning sprint, which can be used for mastering skills in various areas, or more freely investigating ideas with prototypes. It is important that our people learn and grow constantly, and SimCorp invests a lot to foster the continuous learning environment to support people on their journeys.

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

Benefits

An attractive salary, bonus scheme, and pension are essential components of any employment package. At SimCorp, we believe we can offer more. In addition to the traditional benefits, we promote an effective work-life balance, including flexible work hours and a hybrid workplace model. As a large organization, we offer a wide range of career opportunities, with an individualized approach to professional development to support the career path you wish to pursue.

NEXT STEPS

Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible. We process incoming applications continually . Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed.
At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.

If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.  

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

WHO WE ARE?

For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds. 

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients. 

SimCorp is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

Vil du hjælpe kunder med at omsætte forretningsbehov til stærke løsninger på Microsoft-platformen?

Hos Evidi søger vi en Senior Forretningskonsulent
inden for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement og Power Platform.
Vi leder efter dig, der har solid erfaring med Dynamics 365 CE og Power Platform, og som trives i krydsfeltet mellem forretning og teknologi. Du motiveres af at forstå kundernes behov, facilitere de rigtige dialoger og omsætte forretningskrav til løsninger, der skaber værdi.
Du bliver en vigtig del af vores CE & Power Platform-forretning, hvor du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med både kunder, kolleger og løsningsarkitekter om at skabe fremtidens digitale løsninger.
📍 Vi søger i hele landet, og du kan blive ansat på en af vores lokationer i Thisted, Aarhus, Vejle, Odense, Ballerup eller København.

Hvad kan du forvente i rollen?

Som Senior Forretningskonsulent bliver du en central rådgiver for vores kunder og en vigtig del af deres digitale transformation.
Du arbejder tæt sammen med kunder, projektledere, arkitekter og udviklere for at sikre, at løsningerne understøtter forretningens mål og processer.

Du vil blandt andet:
Facilitere workshops og afklaringsforløb med forretning og IT
Analysere forretningsprocesser og omsætte behov til løsningsdesign
Rådgive kunder om Dynamics 365 CE og Power Platform
Arbejde med Dynamics 365 Sales, Customer Service, Field Service og Project Operations
Designe løsninger baseret på Dataverse, Power Apps og Power Automate
Samarbejde med arkitekter og udviklere om integrationer, data og sikkerhed
Bidrage til estimater, tilbud og presales-aktiviteter
Kvalitetssikre leverancer og bidrage til udvikling af metoder og best practices
Sparre med kolleger og dele erfaringer på tværs af projekter og fagområder

Du behøver ikke være specialist i alle tekniske detaljer, men du har en stærk forståelse for platformen og kan bygge bro mellem forretning og teknologi.

Hvem er du?
Du har erfaring med Dynamics 365 CE og Power Platform og har været involveret i implementering af forretningskritiske løsninger.
Du kan navigere mellem forretning og teknologi og er komfortabel med dialogen med både brugere, projektgrupper og beslutningstagere.

Har erfaring med Power Apps og Power Automate
Har forståelse for Dataverse og integrationsscenarier
Er stærk i analyse, workshopfacilitering og kravspecificering

Bidrager aktivt til samarbejde og videndeling

Spændende og komplekse kundeprojekter

Stor indflydelse på din egen udvikling
Mulighed for certificering og kompetenceudvikling
Fleksibilitet i hverdagen
Korte beslutningsveje og plads til initiativ

Hvis du brænder for Dynamics 365 CE, Power Platform og kundeværdi, vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.
Du behøver ikke kunne sætte flueben ved alt. Hvis rollen og ambitionerne taler til dig, så tag fat i os.

jobs.title: Principal CRM Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Description

Role Mission:

The Principal CRM Engineer defines and evolves the architecture of StarHub’s core Customer Relationship Management (CRM) and Order Management (OM) platforms that power customer onboarding, sales journeys, and fulfilment for the Consumer Business.

The role focuses on building a scalable, resilient, and future-ready CRM/OM platform, ensuring seamless end-to-end customer experiences and enabling rapid product innovation. Operating within a DevOps model, the Principal CRM Engineer drives platform modernization, architectural standardization, and system-wide reliability, while guiding engineering teams to eliminate systemic issues and scale the platform sustainably.

Responsibilities:

Define and own the end-to-end architecture of CRM/OM platforms across Customer Management, Product Catalogue, Campaigns, Order Management, and Revenue/Billing integration

Establish architectural principles and standards for microservices, API design, workflow orchestration, and data management across CRM/OM domains
Design and optimize workflow orchestration strategies for order lifecycle processes, ensuring scalability and fault tolerance
Drive platform scalability and performance improvements by identifying system bottlenecks across APIs, databases, and workflows
Define and govern data architecture, ensuring consistency, integrity, and efficient data flow across CRM, provisioning, and billing systems
Establish API and integration standards, including versioning, idempotency, and reliability patterns for internal and external system integrations
Lead platform modernization initiatives, including migration from legacy CRM systems to cloud-native CRM-based architecture
Reduce technical debt and system complexity by driving modularization, decoupling, and standardization across services
Define and implement observability and reliability strategies across the platform, ensuring proactive monitoring, alerting, and performance optimization
Collaborate with DevOps and platform teams to design scalable cloud-native solutions using Kubernetes (EKS), CI/CD pipelines, and Infrastructure as Code
Act as the technical authority for design decisions, conducting architecture reviews and ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture and business objectives
Mentor CRM Engineers on system design, architectural thinking, and advanced debugging techniques
Influence cross-functional teams and stakeholders to adopt consistent engineering standards and best practices
Collaborate with Product Owners, QA, DevOps, and vendors to ensure seamless integration and delivery of end-to-end customer journeys

Qualifications

10+ years of professional software engineering experience with a strong emphasis on system architecture and large ‑ scale distributed systems
Demonstrated ability to design, evolve, and operate enterprise ‑ critical platforms, particularly within CRM, OM, BSS, or comparable domains
Deep architectural expertise across:
Microservices and distributed system design
API design, integration patterns, and service contracts
Workflow driven and orchestration-based systems
Data architecture, modelling, and database performance optimization
Strong hands-on technical experience with:
Java, Spring Boot, and RESTful API design/development
PostgreSQL and/or Oracle, including query optimization and performance tuning
Kubernetes based platforms and cloud environments (AWS preferred)
Proven experience working in telecom BSS/OSS environments, including CRM, billing, and order management systems
Established track record of leading platform modernization, large scale refactoring, and transformation initiatives in complex enterprise environments

Preferred Certifications

Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) or Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD)
AWS Certified Solutions Architect (Associate or Professional)

Description

RecoTek is Reconomy’s new centralized technology hub located in Bucharest, Romania, officially launched in February 2024. Serving as the backbone of Reconomy’s tech operations, it consolidates inhouse expertise across all Reconomy brands to accelerate platform development and enhance service delivery.

Reconomy is an international circular economy specialist that combines technology, skills and incredible people to enable businesses to better manage their resources, helping reduce waste, optimise their supply chains, and contribute in a meaningful way toward the circular economy

Reconomy is bending the edges of linear business models across the world, integrating circular economy strategies and processes into everyday operations. We have the tools, talent and technology that enable customers to harness the full and inherent value of their resources, with integrated global operations in over 80 countries across the world.

Reconomy’s full range of capabilities are organized into 3 ‘loops’: Recycle, Comply and Re-use, each providing opportunities for circularity within the wider resource cycle.

Recycle loop is utilising the latest technology and data to enable customers to make the best possible use of their materials.

Comply loop is enabling customers to solve increasingly complex environmental regulatory challenges using data, expert knowledge and thought leadership to drive business accountability across the globe.

Re-use loop is providing intelligent technology platforms and agile delivery models for pre-retail logistics and product returns, fulfilment and processing, on behalf of many of Europe’s largest retailers.

jobs.title: Software Engineer (AI-Native)
jobs.description:
Software Engineer

Despre noi

Suntem un start-up care sprijină SOLOprenorii în drumul lor spre succes. Peste 30.000 de freelanceri, medici, IT-iști și antreprenori români au ales în ultimii 5 ani să își gestioneze PFA-ul cu SOLO, și asta ne face și mai ambițioși. Vrem să ajungem cât mai curând la 100.000 de clienți activi. Misiunea noastră este să transformăm birocrația într-un sistem simplu, digital și automatizat.

Despre ce este rolul?

Construim un produs folosit deja de zeci de mii de oameni și vrem să-l ducem la următorul nivel.

Problema pe care o rezolvăm nu e simplă: legislație complicată, multe excepții și așteptări mari de la utilizatori.

Căutăm un engineer care vrea să contribuie la soluții reale și să crească într-un mediu cu impact direct în produs.

Misiunea ta în acest rol

Vei lucra pe probleme reale ale utilizatorilor noștri , unele bine definite, altele în curs de clarificare
Vei contribui la implementarea și îmbunătățirea sistemelor existente
Vei colabora cu echipa pentru a livra funcționalități în producție
Vei participa la decizii tehnice și vei învăța cum să le iei în timp
Vei folosi AI în workflow-ul tău pentru a crește viteza și calitatea

Ce ne dorim de la tine

2–4 ani experiență în dezvoltare software;
Experiență cu backend (ideal .NET Core, dar nu obligatoriu);
Experiență cu baze de date relaționale și modelare de date;
Capacitatea de a lucra pe probleme care nu sunt complet definite;
Interes pentru produs și modul în care este folosit de utilizatori;
Te folosești de AI (Cursor, Claude, Copilot sau similar) pentru a-ți îmbunătăți modul de lucru și înveți să validezi output-ul.

Ce oferim

Salariu competitiv (în funcție de nivel);
Zile nelimitate de concediu (pe care le și folosim);
Program flexibil;
Abonament premium la clinicile medicale Regina Maria;
Abonament Bookster;
Acces la tool-uri AI (Claude, Cursor, Copilot etc.) și buget de utilizare;
Lucrăm hibrid din București. Poți lucra până la 2 zile pe săptămână de acasă. În perioada de probă, te așteptăm zilnic la birou: e cea mai rapidă cale să înțelegi contextul, să cunoști echipa, și să ajungi să livrezi pe cont propriu.

Despre cum lucrăm în general

Modul În Care Lucrăm Este Influențat De Valorile În Care Credem Și Pe Care Ne Propunem Să Le Aplicăm În Tot Ce Facem

Creșterea continuă și accelerată e ceva fundamental - ne așteptăm de la fiecare coleg să își dorească să se dezvolte și să profite pe deplin de toate resursele pe care le punem la dispoziție pentru învățare. Apoi, ne așteptăm ca fiecare coleg să fie interesat mai ales de rezultat, nu doar de efort în sine.
Clientul este în centrul activității noastre: îi înțelegem nevoia reală, îl tratăm cu empatie și alegem soluții simple și clare pentru el. Facem toate acestea în timp ce ne comportăm cu bunăvoință unii față de alții, oferim și acceptăm feedback și menținem și consolidăm un spirit de echipă în care să ne regăsim cu toții.
Fiind un start-up, ne dorim alături oameni energici, curajosi, autonomi, cu o gândire dincolo de tipare, cu simțul umorului și cu o mare flexibilitate mentală, pentru că adesea realitatea din jur și activitățile noastre de zi cu zi se schimbă din mers în timp ce direcția rămâne clară: suntem aici pentru a sprijini SOLOprenorii.

adesso Belgium, who are we?
We are an IT (start-up) provider working under the adesso umbrella with proven track record in different industries. The new Belgian entity of adesso

Do you want to make data truly work
? At adesso, we are looking for Data Engineers who know how to translate complex data issues into scalable, efficient solutions. Someone who embraces cloud technology, but also understands that good data solutions start with understanding the process behind the numbers.

Job Requirements

As a Data Architect at adesso, you design and guide the implementation of modern data platforms on Azure, with a strong focus on Lakehouse architectures
using Databricks
and Microsoft Fabric
. You translate business goals into pragmatic data architectures, guard the overall coherence, and help teams deliver scalable, secure and future‑proof solutions.

You will join our growing Data & AI team in Belgium
, working closely with experienced colleagues from adesso in the Netherlands and across Europe. You get the opportunity to help build a new practice, while benefiting from the knowledge, assets and stability of an established international company.

Your Role In Projects

Define data architectures & roadmaps

Design end‑to‑end data architectures on Azure, covering ingestion, storage, processing, serving and governance.
Shape Lakehouse / data platform blueprints using technologies such as Azure Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Lake, Azure Synapse, Azure Data Factory.
Translate business objectives and requirements into architectural roadmaps, target architectures and transition steps.

Choose and align technologies

Evaluate and position Databricks vs Microsoft Fabric vs other Azure components depending on the client context and use cases.
Define reference patterns (e.g. medallion architecture, CDC patterns, data sharing, semantic layers) and promote them across projects.
Collaborate with cloud architects, security, and domain experts to ensure solutions are aligned with enterprise standards and constraints.

Guide implementation & support teams

Work closely with data engineers, analytics engineers, BI developers and data scientists to make architecture real.
Provide guidance on data modeling (dimensional modeling / star schema, data vault, operational models) and data product design.
Review solution designs, pipelines and models, and help troubleshoot complex issues when needed.

Data governance, security & quality

Define and promote data governance principles (ownership, cataloguing, lineage, metadata, classification).
Work with security teams to implement secure-by-design architectures (RBAC, least privilege, PII/PHI handling, encryption).
Advocate and help implement data quality and observability practices (DQ checks, monitoring, alerting).

Hands-on architecture & prototyping

Stay close to the technology by building proofs of concept, reference implementations and accelerators.
Use tools like Databricks (PySpark, SQL), Fabric Lakehouses, Notebooks, Data Pipelines, Power BI to validate patterns and decisions.

Mentor data engineers and other team members who want to grow towards architecture roles.

Required Technical Skills & Knowledge

Azure databricks, Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Apache Spark, Azure Synapse, Azure Data Lake, Azure Data Factory, Python, PySpark, SQL

Solid experience designing and implementing data solutions on Azure, with exposure to Databricks and/or Microsoft Fabric.
Strong understanding of modern data platform and Lakehouse concepts (medallion architecture, Delta/Parquet, OneLake, Lakehouses, semantic models).
Strong data modeling skills for analytics: dimensional modeling / star schema is a must; data vault or 3NF is a plus.
Hands‑on background in data engineering (SQL, Python/PySpark, ETL/ELT, orchestration) and comfort diving into technical details when needed.
Familiarity with Power BI or similar analytics tools, and how architecture impacts reporting, self‑service BI and semantic models.
Understanding of CI/CD, DevOps and infrastructure‑as‑code practices (Azure DevOps, GitHub, Terraform/Bicep) in the context of data platforms.
Knowledge of data governance, security and compliance in the cloud (RBAC, DLP, lineage, catalog, audit) and how to embed them into architecture.

Consulting & Soft Skills

You enjoy working with stakeholders from both business and IT, and you can challenge and clarify requirements.
You can explain architectural options, trade‑offs and decisions in a clear and structured way, adapted to your audience.
You are comfortable facilitating workshops and guiding teams through architectural choices.
You are proactive, pragmatic and solution‑oriented: you balance “good architecture” with delivery constraints.
You communicate fluently in French and/or Dutch and are fluent in English. (both written & spoken)
This position requires current residency and work authorization in Belgium; relocation from other continents cannot be accommodated.

The Offer Of The Data & AI Team

Growth & learning

A key role in shaping the Data & AI practice in Belgium, with direct impact on our reference architectures, methods and technology choices.
Close collaboration with our Dutch Data & AI team and the wider adesso group, giving you access to a broad community of experts and proven accelerators.

A people‑oriented culture focused on collaboration, trust and entrepreneurship.

A hybrid way of working with a healthy balance between client‑site, office and home.

Why join adesso Belgium?

Meaningful work and projects: work within your domain of expertise where you can create value for customers and grow together with the company
Strategic opinion: your opinion and contribution to the expansion of the company is very valuable, it counts! You can give the company direction bringing in your ideas, creativity and vision for future growth!

Global Reach with Local Expertise: you will be part of a small agile company where our culture code will drive us to success. As part of an international company we are supported in different domains with expertise and top notch reference cases!

Do you want to turn business challenges into smart, scalable solutions with Microsoft Power Platform? At Tieto Tech Consulting, we work at the intersection of technology, consulting, and customer value - helping organizations automate processes and build modern digital solutions that make daily work easier and more impactful.

With over 8,000 colleagues worldwide and around 300 colleagues in the DACH region, we combine industry insight, software engineering, cloud expertise, data capabilities, and enterprise solutions know-how to help our customers design, build, and run their digital businesses.

We are looking for a Microsoft Power Platform Architect who can take ownership of enterprise-level solution architectures, guide customers in strategic technology decisions, and translate complex business needs into scalable, secure and future-ready Microsoft ecosystem solutions. If you are passionate about architecture, governance, cloud technologies and creating sustainable business value with Power Platform, this role offers the opportunity to shape impactful solutions together with skilled colleagues and forward-thinking customers.

When joining Tieto Tech Consulting as a Microsoft Power Platform Architect, you

Define and own end-to-end Power Platform architectures, ensuring scalable, secure and sustainable solution designs across Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI and Power Pages
Advise customers on best practices for Power Platform governance and lifecycle management
Lead the architectural integration of Power Platform solutions into broader Microsoft 365 and Azure ecosystems, aligning technical decisions with enterprise standards and customer strategy
Facilitate architecture workshops, guide decision-making with customers and provide expert recommendations on solution design, governance and technical roadmaps
Stay up-to-date with Microsoft certifications and contribute to internal capability building

Who We Are Looking For

We value diverse backgrounds and welcome candidates who bring:

5+ years of hands-on experience in a similar role
Very good knowledge of Cloud Enterprise Architecture, Power Platform, Azure and Azure AI ecosystems
A completed degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a comparable qualification
Certifications such as PL-200, PL-400, PL-600 or PL-900 are a plus
Hands-on knowledge of Azure AI Foundry, Copilot Studio, and GPT-based solutions
Strong understanding of low-code/no-code development principles
Good programming skills, preferably with C#/.NET
Ability to translate business needs into technical solutions
A consulting mindset and strong communication skills in both German and English
Passion for continuous learning and staying up-to-date with new developments

As an individual, you are a team player who takes initiative and ownership. You communicate clearly, organize your work effectively, and enjoy solving complex challenges. You’re eager to learn and share knowledge, and you thrive in a fast-evolving technology landscape.

We offer

Collaboration with highly skilled experts across Europe and beyond
A culture built on trust, collaboration, and continuous learning
Flexible hybrid working models and modern ways of working
Benefits like laptop and smartphone also for private use, health programs, team events, excellent public transport connection, food vouchers, contribution to the costs of the Austrian “Klimaticket”, fresh fruits, the perfect environment to prosper professionally, and a lot more
Continuous professional development and international career opportunities
An attractive compensation package including performance-based incentives

The monthly gross salary for this position will start from € 4.476,00 (based on IT collective agreement, ST1 Erfahrungsstufe) on a full-time basis, depending on your qualifications and experience. Our aim is to provide you with a salary package that is both competitive and reflective of your relevant experience, while also aligning with current market standards.

If this sounds like the right opportunity for you, we would love to hear from you. Please attach your CV or LinkedIn profile, and we will get in touch.

If you have any questions regarding this role, please contact us: careers.austria@tieto.com.

We’re also happy to connect you with one of your future colleagues for an informal conversation. It’s a great opportunity to hear first-hand what the role looks like, how we work and what it’s like to be part of the team.

Please note that while we are happy to answer questions via email, we can only consider applications submitted through our online application system and therefore cannot accept applications sent directly by email.

Locations:
Vienna, Linz, Graz

Additional Information

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.

jobs.title: Backend Engineer — Founding Engineering Team
jobs.description:
Backend Engineer — Founding Engineering Team

AtheerB — AI Beauty-Tech
📍 Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
💼 Equity-Based | No Salary at This Stage
🏢 Reporting to HP — AtheerB / Get Started V, Riyadh
🚀 Founding Engineering Team

AtheerB is building an AI-powered beauty technology platform designed to transform how people understand their skin, hair, beauty routines and product choices.

We are looking for a strong Backend Engineer to join our founding engineering team and help build the technical foundation behind AtheerB.

This is not a maintenance role.

You will help design and build the systems connecting our customer applications, AI engines, databases, internal CRM, product intelligence, commerce partners and future mobile experiences.

What We Are Building

The AtheerB technology ecosystem will include:

• AI-powered skin and hair analysis
• AI Beauty Consultant
• Personalized beauty routines
• Product recommendation engine
• Ingredient intelligence
• Before/after progress tracking
• Customer accounts and profiles
• Arabic and English experiences
• Internal CRM and administration platform
• Partner commerce integrations
• Product catalog, pricing and inventory integrations
• AI-powered automation
• Secure customer and image-data infrastructure

Our ambition is to build from Riyadh and scale across Saudi Arabia, the GCC and international markets.

Your Mission

As Backend Engineer, you will work closely with the CTO, Senior Full-Stack Engineer, AI/ML Engineers and product team to build the backend architecture powering AtheerB.

You will take ownership of critical services from architecture through production.

Your work will sit at the intersection of:

Software + Data + AI + Commerce + Customer Experience

Key Responsibilities

• Design and build scalable backend services and APIs
• Develop the core application architecture
• Design and maintain PostgreSQL database structures
• Build authentication, authorization and permissions systems
• Develop customer profiles and account services
• Build APIs connecting frontend and mobile applications
• Integrate AI/ML and computer-vision services into production workflows
• Build selfie/image upload and processing pipelines
• Develop AI job queues and asynchronous processing workflows
• Build recommendation and personalization services
• Develop product and ingredient data infrastructure
• Build internal CRM and administration APIs
• Integrate payment and commerce services
• Integrate partner catalogs, pricing, inventory and order APIs
• Build notification and communication services
• Implement caching, queues and background workers
• Develop audit logging and operational monitoring
• Implement secure data-storage and deletion workflows
• Improve backend performance and reliability
• Build automated tests
• Participate in architecture and code reviews
• Support CI/CD and production deployments
• Troubleshoot and resolve production issues

Technical Experience

We are particularly interested in engineers with strong experience in:

• Python and/or TypeScript
• FastAPI, Django, Node.js, NestJS or similar frameworks
• PostgreSQL
• REST APIs
• API architecture and documentation
• Authentication and authorization
• Redis or similar caching technologies
• Background jobs and message queues
• Docker
• Git
• CI/CD
• AWS, GCP or Azure
• Object storage
• Logging and monitoring
• Automated testing
• Secure backend development

Experience with Firebase, Supabase or similar technologies is valuable, but you should understand the underlying architecture rather than depending entirely on low-code platforms.

AI-Native Backend Engineering

AtheerB is an AI-first platform.

You will be responsible for helping turn AI models into reliable product capabilities.

Experience with the following is highly valuable:

• LLM APIs
• Multimodal AI APIs
• Computer-vision services
• AI model inference APIs
• Structured AI outputs
• RAG systems
• Vector databases
• Embeddings
• AI agents and tool calling
• Recommendation systems
• AI orchestration
• Model/API fallback strategies
• AI usage and cost monitoring

We are particularly interested in engineers who understand that putting an AI API behind an endpoint is only the beginning.

Production AI requires reliability, observability, security, evaluation, fallbacks and cost control.

Architecture Matters

As an early Backend Engineer, you will influence technical decisions that may remain with AtheerB for years.

We expect you to think carefully about:

Scalability — Can the system support significant customer growth?

Security — How should customer and image data be protected?

Reliability — What happens when an AI provider or external API fails?

Performance — How quickly can analysis and recommendations reach customers?

Cost — How can infrastructure and AI inference costs remain sustainable?

Modularity — Can we replace AI providers without rebuilding the platform?

Data — Can our architecture eventually support proprietary intelligence and personalization?

Security & Privacy

AtheerB will process customer information and images.

Security and privacy therefore need to be part of the engineering architecture from day one.

You will help implement:

• Encryption
• Role-based access controls
• Secure authentication
• API security
• Audit logs
• Data minimization
• Consent-aware data workflows
• Image retention and deletion mechanisms
• Backup and recovery systems
• Secure secrets management
• Monitoring and incident visibility

You should understand the importance of privacy-by-design when building consumer AI products.

AI-Assisted Development

We expect our engineering team to use modern AI development tools responsibly to accelerate execution.

You should be comfortable using AI for:

• Coding
• Debugging
• Testing
• Refactoring
• Documentation
• Architecture exploration
• API development
• Code review
• Development automation

We value engineering judgment and product quality over simply producing large amounts of code.

Who We Are Looking For

You may be a strong fit if you:

• Have built production backend systems
• Understand architecture, not just individual endpoints
• Write clean and maintainable code
• Understand relational database design
• Can design reliable APIs
• Have experience integrating third-party services
• Understand authentication and security
• Can integrate AI services into production applications
• Are comfortable working in an early-stage environment
• Can work independently and take ownership
• Communicate technical trade-offs clearly
• Want to help build a company rather than simply complete tickets

Experience in AI, beauty-tech, health-tech, e-commerce, consumer technology, recommendation systems or high-scale platforms would be particularly valuable.

Founding-Team Mindset

AtheerB is at an early stage.

You will not inherit a perfect engineering environment.

You will help create it.

We are looking for someone who can move from:

Problem → Architecture → Code → Test → Production → Monitor → Improve

You should be comfortable with ambiguity, rapid iteration and significant ownership.

Equity-Based Opportunity

This is an equity-based founding-team position.

There is no salary at the current stage.

Equity will be structured with vesting and aligned with contribution, responsibilities, commitment and long-term value creation.

This opportunity is intended for someone who wants ownership in what they are helping build and understands the risks and potential upside of joining an early-stage venture.

Please do not apply if you are currently seeking exclusively salaried employment.

Location

Riyadh, Saudi Arabia

The position reports to the CTO of AtheerB, with AtheerB operating under Get Started V in Riyadh.

Preference will be given to candidates based in Riyadh or willing to relocate.

Application

Please submit:

• CV / Resume
• LinkedIn profile
• GitHub profile
• Technical portfolio where applicable
• Examples of backend systems or products you have built

Please also answer:

1. What is the most complex backend system you have personally built?
2. Which parts of its architecture did you own?
3. What is your preferred backend stack and why?
4. Have you integrated LLM, computer-vision or other AI services into production?
5. How would you architect a backend handling customer selfies and asynchronous AI analysis?
6. How would you design the platform so AI providers can be replaced without rebuilding the application?
7. How would you secure sensitive customer and image data?
8. Which AI coding and development tools do you currently use?
9. Are you comfortable joining on an equity-only basis with no salary at this stage?
10. Are you based in Riyadh or willing to relocate?

Building the intelligence layer for the future of beauty.

Dich fasziniert, dass kein Kunde dem anderen gleicht, und du arbeitest gerne in einem Team, das gemeinsam die jeweils besten Lösungen für individuelle Anforderungen entwickelt.

Du bist auch analytisch veranlagt und in der Lage, die Daten und Ergebnisse deiner Testszenarien zu nutzen, um sie anzupassen, zu verbessern und erneut zu testen. So gestaltest du Kundensysteme so robust, zuverlässig und effektiv wie möglich.

als auch in Teilzeit
möglich.

Verantwortlichkeiten

In Deiner Rolle als Performance Engineer liegt Dein Aufgabenschwerpunkt in der Unterstützung unserer Kunden bei der Implementierung performance-kritischer IT-Systeme – End to End und Full-Stack.

Build services with clear dependency management, access controls and logging so their behaviour can be understood in production.
Investigate problems across APIs, data processing and messaging, including failures caused by the way systems interact.
Compare new calculations with existing outcomes in shadow mode before allowing changes to affect live processing.
Refactor SQL Server logic carefully, preserving the correctness of client-money handling.

Senior hands-on experience with .NET 6+ and .NET Framework 4.8, including MVC5, WebAPI 2 and Entity Framework 6.
Deep SQL Server experience and confidence reading and safely changing complex stored procedures.
Working JavaScript or TypeScript knowledge and the ability to follow behaviour across application and database code.
A measured approach to modernisation, using tests and comparison of outputs to demonstrate that changes are safe.

Useful Additional Experience

Experience with AWS Lambda, SQS, SNS or RDS would help. This could suit a senior .NET engineer who finds satisfaction in untangling established systems and improving them incrementally, with correctness taking priority over a particular architectural fashion.

new_jobs.title: Backend Engineer — Founding Engineering Team
new_jobs.description:
Backend Engineer — Founding Engineering Team

AtheerB — AI Beauty-Tech
📍 Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
💼 Equity-Based | No Salary at This Stage
🏢 Reporting to HP — AtheerB / Get Started V, Riyadh
🚀 Founding Engineering Team

AtheerB is building an AI-powered beauty technology platform designed to transform how people understand their skin, hair, beauty routines and product choices.

We are looking for a strong Backend Engineer to join our founding engineering team and help build the technical foundation behind AtheerB.

This is not a maintenance role.

You will help design and build the systems connecting our customer applications, AI engines, databases, internal CRM, product intelligence, commerce partners and future mobile experiences.

What We Are Building

The AtheerB technology ecosystem will include:

• AI-powered skin and hair analysis
• AI Beauty Consultant
• Personalized beauty routines
• Product recommendation engine
• Ingredient intelligence
• Before/after progress tracking
• Customer accounts and profiles
• Arabic and English experiences
• Internal CRM and administration platform
• Partner commerce integrations
• Product catalog, pricing and inventory integrations
• AI-powered automation
• Secure customer and image-data infrastructure

Our ambition is to build from Riyadh and scale across Saudi Arabia, the GCC and international markets.

Your Mission

As Backend Engineer, you will work closely with the CTO, Senior Full-Stack Engineer, AI/ML Engineers and product team to build the backend architecture powering AtheerB.

You will take ownership of critical services from architecture through production.

Your work will sit at the intersection of:

Software + Data + AI + Commerce + Customer Experience

Key Responsibilities

• Design and build scalable backend services and APIs
• Develop the core application architecture
• Design and maintain PostgreSQL database structures
• Build authentication, authorization and permissions systems
• Develop customer profiles and account services
• Build APIs connecting frontend and mobile applications
• Integrate AI/ML and computer-vision services into production workflows
• Build selfie/image upload and processing pipelines
• Develop AI job queues and asynchronous processing workflows
• Build recommendation and personalization services
• Develop product and ingredient data infrastructure
• Build internal CRM and administration APIs
• Integrate payment and commerce services
• Integrate partner catalogs, pricing, inventory and order APIs
• Build notification and communication services
• Implement caching, queues and background workers
• Develop audit logging and operational monitoring
• Implement secure data-storage and deletion workflows
• Improve backend performance and reliability
• Build automated tests
• Participate in architecture and code reviews
• Support CI/CD and production deployments
• Troubleshoot and resolve production issues

Technical Experience

We are particularly interested in engineers with strong experience in:

• Python and/or TypeScript
• FastAPI, Django, Node.js, NestJS or similar frameworks
• PostgreSQL
• REST APIs
• API architecture and documentation
• Authentication and authorization
• Redis or similar caching technologies
• Background jobs and message queues
• Docker
• Git
• CI/CD
• AWS, GCP or Azure
• Object storage
• Logging and monitoring
• Automated testing
• Secure backend development

Experience with Firebase, Supabase or similar technologies is valuable, but you should understand the underlying architecture rather than depending entirely on low-code platforms.

AI-Native Backend Engineering

AtheerB is an AI-first platform.

You will be responsible for helping turn AI models into reliable product capabilities.

Experience with the following is highly valuable:

• LLM APIs
• Multimodal AI APIs
• Computer-vision services
• AI model inference APIs
• Structured AI outputs
• RAG systems
• Vector databases
• Embeddings
• AI agents and tool calling
• Recommendation systems
• AI orchestration
• Model/API fallback strategies
• AI usage and cost monitoring

We are particularly interested in engineers who understand that putting an AI API behind an endpoint is only the beginning.

Production AI requires reliability, observability, security, evaluation, fallbacks and cost control.

Architecture Matters

As an early Backend Engineer, you will influence technical decisions that may remain with AtheerB for years.

We expect you to think carefully about:

Scalability — Can the system support significant customer growth?

Security — How should customer and image data be protected?

Reliability — What happens when an AI provider or external API fails?

Performance — How quickly can analysis and recommendations reach customers?

Cost — How can infrastructure and AI inference costs remain sustainable?

Modularity — Can we replace AI providers without rebuilding the platform?

Data — Can our architecture eventually support proprietary intelligence and personalization?

Security & Privacy

AtheerB will process customer information and images.

Security and privacy therefore need to be part of the engineering architecture from day one.

You will help implement:

• Encryption
• Role-based access controls
• Secure authentication
• API security
• Audit logs
• Data minimization
• Consent-aware data workflows
• Image retention and deletion mechanisms
• Backup and recovery systems
• Secure secrets management
• Monitoring and incident visibility

You should understand the importance of privacy-by-design when building consumer AI products.

AI-Assisted Development

We expect our engineering team to use modern AI development tools responsibly to accelerate execution.

You should be comfortable using AI for:

• Coding
• Debugging
• Testing
• Refactoring
• Documentation
• Architecture exploration
• API development
• Code review
• Development automation

We value engineering judgment and product quality over simply producing large amounts of code.

Who We Are Looking For

You may be a strong fit if you:

• Have built production backend systems
• Understand architecture, not just individual endpoints
• Write clean and maintainable code
• Understand relational database design
• Can design reliable APIs
• Have experience integrating third-party services
• Understand authentication and security
• Can integrate AI services into production applications
• Are comfortable working in an early-stage environment
• Can work independently and take ownership
• Communicate technical trade-offs clearly
• Want to help build a company rather than simply complete tickets

Experience in AI, beauty-tech, health-tech, e-commerce, consumer technology, recommendation systems or high-scale platforms would be particularly valuable.

Founding-Team Mindset

AtheerB is at an early stage.

You will not inherit a perfect engineering environment.

You will help create it.

We are looking for someone who can move from:

Problem → Architecture → Code → Test → Production → Monitor → Improve

You should be comfortable with ambiguity, rapid iteration and significant ownership.

Equity-Based Opportunity

This is an equity-based founding-team position.

There is no salary at the current stage.

Equity will be structured with vesting and aligned with contribution, responsibilities, commitment and long-term value creation.

This opportunity is intended for someone who wants ownership in what they are helping build and understands the risks and potential upside of joining an early-stage venture.

Please do not apply if you are currently seeking exclusively salaried employment.

Location

Riyadh, Saudi Arabia

The position reports to the CTO of AtheerB, with AtheerB operating under Get Started V in Riyadh.

Preference will be given to candidates based in Riyadh or willing to relocate.

Application

Please submit:

• CV / Resume
• LinkedIn profile
• GitHub profile
• Technical portfolio where applicable
• Examples of backend systems or products you have built

Please also answer:

1. What is the most complex backend system you have personally built?
2. Which parts of its architecture did you own?
3. What is your preferred backend stack and why?
4. Have you integrated LLM, computer-vision or other AI services into production?
5. How would you architect a backend handling customer selfies and asynchronous AI analysis?
6. How would you design the platform so AI providers can be replaced without rebuilding the application?
7. How would you secure sensitive customer and image data?
8. Which AI coding and development tools do you currently use?
9. Are you comfortable joining on an equity-only basis with no salary at this stage?
10. Are you based in Riyadh or willing to relocate?
